audience: product teams and creators who make speech audio, transcripts and voices with Cartesia

useCases.title: Read text aloud in a chosen voice
useCases.text: Choose a voice and a model, then generate speech from the text. The audio comes back as mp3 or wav. Audio above 2 MB is refused, so split long text.

useCases.title: Transcribe an audio recording
useCases.text: Send an audio file to the Ink speech-to-text model. Get the text, the spoken language and the duration.

useCases.title: Search voices by language or gender
useCases.text: Search your voices and the public library by text, language or gender. Read one voice and the accents it can use.

useCases.title: Create a localized voice in another accent
useCases.text: List the accents that a voice can be localized into. Create a new voice from one of your voices in another accent, such as British.

useCases.title: Clone a voice with the speaker's consent
useCases.text: Create a voice from one audio clip of up to 2.5 MB. Use it only for a speaker who gave explicit consent, as the Cartesia policy requires.

useCases.title: Check credit use before a large batch
useCases.text: Read the credit usage of the account for a time window. Check it before a large batch of audio.
